images.name: 折纸小庭
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one finished landscape 3:2 UI DESIGN BOARD for game "Little Elsewhere", direction "47 折纸小庭 / ORIGAMI GARDEN". Input image 1 is the LOCKED existing window-world background, used as an unmodified image insert in the main game viewport. DO NOT repaint, recolor, simplify, paper-cut, pixelize, crop, or otherwise change the landscape. Preserve original tree, birds, nest, river, natural shoreline, town, snow mountains, daylight sky, pots, cup and green book. ONLY THE INTERFACE should be made from paper. 

Board layout: thin title header; about 65% of board is full main gameplay view; about 30% is a light neutral strip BELOW AND OUTSIDE GAME containing THREE enlarged interface-state examples, visibly separated from gameplay. Keep main HUD footprint around 10–14%, only near edges, with at most one tiny contextual notice, central mountains and river totally open. Rich usable interface: collection, visits, feeding, event notifications, focus and sound. Not just three text buttons.

STRONGLY DISTINCTIVE UI CONSTRUCTION, not cream rounded rectangles: crisp layered cut-paper silhouettes with folded triangular corners and stepped accordion pleats, hard offset paper shadows, visible folds, die-cut leaf/bird openings, faceted origami tabs. Matte pastel peach, mint, pale periwinkle and slate ink. Paper silhouettes visibly define every UI control; no generic rounded pills or painted wooden plaques. Clean contemporary paper engineering, playful but restrained.

Main gameplay HUD: upper-left a small folded mint triangular weather corner tag with cutout sun and "晴日". Along the lower-left window ledge, an open accordion of FOUR VERY SMALL folded tabs with bird/bug/mountain/star die-cut icons, tiny counts "4/10", "2/7", "3/8", "1/21". Lower-right three compact irregular folded-paper action tabs for a seed pouch "喂食 68%", bookmark "图鉴", and headphones/focus "陪伴"; forms alternate folded trapezoid, leaf and ticket silhouettes, not rectangular generic controls. At the right border one narrow peach folded pop-out bird note "麻雀 · 第3次来访" with tiny unfolding arrow. Leave actual view dominant. Small dotted paper-footprint selection indicator, no big book.

External bottom design strip with three visibly different paper structures, annotated by concise Chinese text:
1 "折页图鉴": a pop-open concertina book showing 4 alternating folded panels with cut-paper sparrow/kingfisher/unknown silhouette cards, one chosen tab sticking above, and tiny "加入珍藏".
2 "投喂纸包": a physical-looking folded seed packet UI with opening flap, small seed-type cutout options, quantity stepper "−  10  +" and triangular-fold button "补充食盘".
3 "奇遇纪念": an unfolded star-shaped origami reward card with tiny aurora vignette, "极光" and 3 stepped paper rarity marks, small fold-away "收录" tab. Clearly show closed -> unfolded hint using a fine arrow, not an animation.
Title typography elegant blocky rounded print and tiny handmade labels, highly legible. Short Chinese text only, no fake paragraphs. Strong shape/material identity immediately apparent at thumbnail scale. Avoid glossy 3D, embroidery, watercolor, oily painterly UI, heavy wood, ornate vines, all-cream journal ribbons. IMPORTANT: retain full original reference scenery with exactly its painted/pixelated appearance; paper style ONLY controls and lower state examples.
images.style_focus: 折纸三角签、手风琴折页图鉴、纸包投喂与星形奇遇纪念

images.name: 墨色闲窗
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one finished landscape 3:2 game interaction DESIGN BOARD, title "48 墨色闲窗 / SUMI & SEAL", small brand "Little Elsewhere". Image 1 is a LOCKED EXISTING GAME SCREENSHOT. Insert its scenery unchanged, with its full existing COLOR and original pixel-painted appearance. Do NOT convert the background to ink, desaturate it, blur it, crop it or change the tree, birds, river, town, mountains, sky, balcony, flowers, cup or green book. ONLY THE NEW UI is black/white Japanese sumi-e ink and one tiny cinnabar-red accent.

A DIFFERENT VISUAL LANGUAGE from generic game dashboards and paper-pill UIs: raw black dry-brush strokes, incomplete brushstroke brackets, narrow vertical washi labels with irregular fibers, elegant vertical Japanese-style typesetting in concise Chinese, small square cinnabar seal stamps, refined sumi bird and leaf pictograms. Two colors only in interface, nearly-black ink and a single small vermilion red. UI WHITE rather than yellow cream. Very little full-panel fill; most main-view controls are small strokes/vertical strips. No rounded pills, no large cream ribbons, no brown parchment, no wood/vines, no shiny materials, no cute scrapbook hearts.

Board composition: thin white ink title header; upper65% large existing COLOR viewport; lower30% white editorial DESIGN SPEC STRIP OUTSIDE THE GAME showing 3 enlarged distinct interaction states. Main overlay occupies 8–12% of viewport edges max, one tiny contextual popover only; center river/mountains entirely unobscured. Design must be useful and clearly interactive, not mere calligraphy decoration.

Main HUD interaction construction: a narrow VERTICAL left-edge rail of four separated washi slips, each small with original sumi pictogram and vertical label "观鸟", "图鉴", "来客", "陪伴". Current "观鸟" has one tiny red square seal. Upper-right small asymmetrical dry-brush circle showing sun symbol and "晴"; a vertical thin date label next to it "初冬・晨". Lower-right feeding control drawn as two unclosed ink brackets around "食盘 68%" and a tiny + seal. At left branch bird, one small white narrow annotation slip connected by fine ink leader, "麻雀", "第三次来访", very compact. Bottom right optional small headphone ink icon. No horizontal rounded button dock. Keep the existing book and cup exposed.

External lower design-strip THREE states with thin incomplete ink separators and small numerical red seals:
1 "一页观察": a graceful partially unrolled white fieldnote, bold brush-ink sparrow drawing, short neat note labels "初遇", "枝桠", "啄食", two black-line actions "收藏" and "回放". Empty space and typographic hierarchy, not a dense paragraph.
2 "自然印谱": a 2x3 grid of square sumi creature seals, three discovered stamps (sparrow, kingfisher, owl) in black, three pale outlined silhouettes, one cinnabar "新" mark. Label "鸟类 3/10", small category tabs expressed as vertical print, not rounded pills.
3 "静听窗外": a beautiful restrained focus-mode panel with a partially open ink enso circle enclosing "25:00", two original ink pictograms for bird song and rain with thin volume bars, a tiny red stop seal. One small visitor bookmark tucked beside it so collecting remains accessible.
Elegant professional game UI concept art, highly legible short Chinese words, clear usable hierarchy. Main image MUST remain original FULL-COLOR landscape, contrast between colorful scenery and crisp black-white-red ink interface. Strongly distinctive at thumbnail scale without huge UI coverage.
images.style_focus: 黑白朱砂印、枯笔竖签导航、水墨图鉴与圆相专注计时

images.name: 星象档案
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished professional landscape 3:2 game INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD. Header "49 星象档案 / STELLAR DECO", small brand "Little Elsewhere". Input image 1 is the LOCKED FULL-COLOR ORIGINAL GAME SCREENSHOT. It must be inserted into the main viewport without changing its daylight, painting style, trees, birds, buildings, river, shoreline, snowy mountains, sun, balcony objects or colors. Do NOT make the world night, add stars or aurora to the main scenery, tint the image navy, or put a full metal frame around it. ART DECO STYLE APPLIES TO UI ONLY.

Board layout: very thin midnight-navy title header with fine brass lines; upper about65% complete original daylight viewport; lower about30% clearly external design-detail strip showing THREE enlarged UI states. Main HUD only around8–12% near screen edges, at most one modest context label; center mountains and river open. External bottom panels can show detail but are not permanent HUD. Strong, immediately recognizable visual identity, quite unlike generic cream stationery or rounded pills.

UI construction: restrained 1930s art-deco celestial observation archive. Deep midnight navy flat panel grounds, warm brass ONE-PIXEL linework, ivory lettering, stepped corners, inset geometric notches, concentric phase circles, tiny fan-ray accents, precise symmetrical engraved star and feather pictograms. Elegant condensed serif titles and small monospaced data labels. Architectural geometric silhouettes rather than heavy metal objects. Matte 2D, no glossy bevels, no heavy ornament, no sci-fi neon. Rich usable information architecture.

Main viewport upper-left tiny stepped hexagonal date/weather tag with sun-disc icon and "晨曦 · 晴"; upper-right compact navy/brass phase dial integrated with two text lines "观测窗口" and "入夜 22:00", about1/7 viewport width only. Right side ONE thin angled notification ribbon "新线索 · 极光" with a small compass-star and bookmark. Along existing lower window ledge a slim stepped observatory index bar, with four elegantly drawn original geometric icons and captions "图鉴", "天象", "来访", "陪伴", tiny collected count "12/50". Small separate seed gauge "68%" and quiet audio symbol. All day scenery remains normal full-color, no vignette, no overlay wash.

Bottom external design strip: three dark-navy UI specimens with ivory text and thin brass dividers, stepped geometric frames, each visually distinct. 1 "现象线索": slim three-column clue tracker with clock/moon/sky pictograms and short labels "晴夜" "22:00 后" "北方天空", checkmarks, little phase arc and button "设为关注". 2 "发现记录": larger art-deco collectible card with a TINY aurora vignette (only this card has night aurora), ivory title "极光", three brass diamond rarity marks, date data and an angular "收入档案" button. 3 "星象档案": six small hexagonal or stepped rectangle archive slots, one aurora card, one meteor motif, four refined unobserved silhouettes, count "2/21", three slim tabs "天空", "水面", "异象". Clear simple arrows show clue tracking -> recorded event -> archive.
Overall premium calm observatory game UI, sophisticated hierarchy, short readable Chinese text, no fake paragraphs, no circles too large. Strong UI form and typography identity, different construction from paper/art-journal designs. Reiterate: retain EXACT original DAYTIME reference imagery in main viewport, no full darkening or repainting.
images.style_focus: 午夜蓝与黄铜线、阶梯几何和扇形角饰、天象相位观测与档案
